summary: The Phase 2 UX result passes at current HEAD 80ff5717ba3a9479bedbe3d9e5ef05d7dd7d1a39. The orchestrator reports that src/ is unchanged from the browser-probed code; the only non-measure change is an unserved scanner test.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] ux-browser-review: The three Phaser 2D flows expose empty accessibility snapshots because the game UI draws in a canvas. Canvas semantics remain unavailable to assistive technology. This is pre-existing and outside the built-in replacements.
evidence: The orchestrator supplied full current HEAD 80ff5717ba3a9479bedbe3d9e5ef05d7dd7d1a39 and reports that it is current.
The orchestrator reports that `git diff --stat 61db4f13 80ff5717ba3a9479bedbe3d9e5ef05d7dd7d1a39 -- src` printed nothing. The source is byte-identical to the code exercised by the browser probe.

The orchestrator reports that `git diff --stat 61db4f13 80ff5717ba3a9479bedbe3d9e5ef05d7dd7d1a39 -- . ':!measure' ':!docs/chibi-sprouts'` lists only `tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts`, which the demo does not serve.
The intervening commits are 9459687d, 48c08742, 39ec5cfa, 27b21d1b, d32aa602, and 80ff5717.
The previous probe and screenshots are unchanged. The probe reports 2 passes, 10 flows reached, all started and moved, and 0 flows with console or page errors.
Pass B deleted `structuredClone`, `Array.prototype.at`, `Array.prototype.findLastIndex`, and `Object.hasOwn` before page scripts. In-page assertions confirmed all four were undefined.
Dragon Flight 2D, Dragon Rider 2D, Spellweavers Run 2D, Spellweavers Run 3D, and the host reader each passed in both modes.
The host-reader flow exercised the `lastIndexWhere` path and marked a sentence.
The Phaser 2D accessibility snapshots are empty in both passes. The 3D Spellweavers and reader snapshots expose accessible text and controls.
The screenshots show active game and reader states only; they do not establish broader visual quality. No audible-quality claim is made.
The previous probe record reports that the server stopped and port 5199 was not listening. This evidence is carried forward.
